non_claims: does not prove published secured churn

owners.owner: Producer client shared stateless idle-connection cache
owners.identity_lease: producer client configuration identity; no group, Share, Streams, or telemetry membership lease

capacity.description: configured idle-cache limit; zero is normalized to one

owners.saturation_policy: FIFO eviction of idle entries; checked-out connections are not evicted
owners.cancellation: request timeout or transport failure poisons the connection before it can return
owners.join_path: cache checkout is synchronous in request ownership; no detached task

owners.owner: Buffered producer enqueue channel and flush worker
owners.identity_lease: producer configuration plus per-delivery deadline; no broker membership identity

capacity.description: configured record channel and batch byte/record limits, each clamped to one

owners.saturation_policy: bounded enqueue applies backpressure and reports closed or canceled senders
owners.cancellation: shutdown closes the enqueue path, fails pending deliveries, and waits for the worker join
owners.join_path: buffered producer close awaits the owned worker handle

owners.identity_lease: Admin client configuration and broker route; no consumer-group generation or transaction producer identity
owners.saturation_policy: reuse only healthy idle connections; discard poisoned or route-incompatible entries
owners.cancellation: request cancellation or I/O failure closes the affected connection and preserves mutation outcome
owners.join_path: Admin operations own request futures; no detached Admin cache task

owners.owner: Direct consumer Fetch session and partition position state
owners.identity_lease: consumer instance, assignment generation, topic/partition, leader epoch, and fetch session id

capacity.description: configured fetch bytes, records, and partition queue capacity

owners.saturation_policy: poll budget and bounded partition queues prevent unbounded record allocation
owners.cancellation: consumer close cancels active fetch and drops the instance-local session
owners.join_path: Fetch request is awaited by the poll owner; no membership heartbeat task is shared

owners.owner: Classic consumer-group membership and heartbeat task
owners.identity_lease: group id, member id, generation, assignment, and coordinator epoch

capacity.description: bounded commit queue and configured heartbeat/rejoin timers

owners.saturation_policy: commit queue coalesces current assignment offsets and rejects overflow
owners.cancellation: group close cancels heartbeat and commit workers, then awaits both task handles
owners.join_path: heartbeat and commit workers are owned by the group membership object

owners.owner: KIP-848 consumer-group membership and heartbeat task
owners.identity_lease: group id, UUID-shaped member id, member epoch, assignment epoch, and topic UUIDs

capacity.description: bounded assignment, commit queue, and heartbeat request state

owners.saturation_policy: assignment updates are applied by epoch; stale or conflicting state requests rejoin
owners.cancellation: KIP-848 close cancels the owned heartbeat request and awaits task termination
owners.join_path: the membership object owns the heartbeat handle and rejoin state

owners.owner: ShareConsumer fetch, acknowledgement, and heartbeat sessions
owners.identity_lease: share group id, member id, member epoch, coordinator, partition lock, and acquired record identity

capacity.description: configured acquisition and acknowledgement queues with bounded in-flight records

owners.saturation_policy: acquisition is bounded; acknowledgement batches are per-record and preserve unknown outcomes
owners.cancellation: close cancels Share heartbeat/fetch work, drains known state, and retains unknown acknowledgement disposition
owners.join_path: Share session owns its heartbeat and broker-session handles; it never enters the generic idle cache

owners.owner: Kafka Streams group membership and task-runtime session
owners.identity_lease: process id, member epoch, assignment epoch, topology, and task identity set

capacity.description: configured task transitions and heartbeat request state

owners.saturation_policy: conflicting assignment is rejected without mutating the task runtime
owners.cancellation: Streams close cancels heartbeat and task commands, then awaits the session handle
owners.join_path: StreamsGroupSessionHandle owns the background heartbeat task and task-runtime command path

owners.identity_lease: telemetry subscription id, negotiated codec, and client metrics provider identity

capacity.description: bounded payload and metric sample limits

owners.saturation_policy: payloads over the configured limit are rejected before send; subscription refreshes in place
owners.cancellation: telemetry close stops the owned push loop and terminates the same-connection subscription
owners.join_path: telemetry provider owns the push future and uses no generic session cache

owners.identity_lease: adapter instance and its synchronous call scope; never a shared async membership lease

capacity.description: one owned runtime per blocking adapter instance

owners.saturation_policy: synchronous calls wait on the owned runtime; nested Tokio runtime use is rejected
owners.cancellation: adapter drop stops the owned runtime after in-flight call completion or explicit task error
owners.join_path: blocking adapter owns the runtime thread and joins it during shutdown
verification: blocking adapter close and runtime ownership review
